shared_elements: low relief carving of figures with linear internal detail
registers or framed panels containing figures
hieroglyph-like or script-like signs alongside figures
justification: Both surfaces show profile human figures in shallow relief, rendered schematically with linear internal detail, accompanied by small script-like signs, and both include figures grasping long staff-like implements. But A is a crowded narrative frieze of many overlapping soldiers, horses and a wheeled chariot moving in one direction, while B is a static, symmetrical votive-style panel with two facing figures (one with a tall headdress/disc) flanking a central column under an arched, winged-motif lunette.
